about:
PC Gamerz Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, where it manufactures custom gaming PCs locally. The company has expanded its reach beyond the Hawaiian Islands to the broader Pacific Rim while maintaining brick-and-mortar locations at the Navy Exchange Pearl Harbor (open to the public) and the Schofield Army PX Main Exchange (military access only). No founding year or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The business assembles preconfigured and custom-themed desktop computers, offers tower and laptop repair, sells individual components in-store, and provides internal foam packing for shipping. It also runs DOE education services and supplies commercial enterprise PCs. Its product lineup includes the GameReady series—Dagger, Shield, Glass Cannon, and Elixir—with a stated seven-day ship time.

Customers span individual gamers, educational institutions through DOE contracts, commercial enterprises, and military personnel via its base exchanges. The company serves both walk-in retail traffic and larger organizational buyers.

PC Gamerz Hawaii emphasizes local manufacturing in Honolulu as a quality differentiator and highlights its seven-day shipping promise as a core service commitment.
